question: Should OpenClaw support the four built-in hosting profiles as durable config, CLI, readiness, and Plugin SDK-adjacent product contracts after the readiness framework is accepted?
rationale: The choice determines whether profile names, selection precedence, readiness semantics, and plugin-provided criteria become supported compatibility commitments; implementation review cannot make that product decision safely.

options.title: Defer the profile contract
options.body: Keep the profile layer paused until maintainers accept the readiness framework and decide whether named deployment postures belong in core.

options.title: Adopt a bounded V1
options.body: Sponsor the four profiles, require a profile-only rebase after the prerequisites land, and require exact-head package-installed Docker evidence before merge.

recommendation.title: Defer the profile contract
recommendation.body: Keep the profile layer paused until maintainers accept the readiness framework and decide whether named deployment postures belong in core.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the strongest visible feature-history context across the prerequisite and profile branches, though product acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
